name: A Noble Brew
summary: In Stormwind, a courier carries Black Claw Stout to Lord Baurles K. Wishock in the Royal Keep. Zardeth of the Black Claw has arranged the delivery from the cellar beneath the Slaughtered Lamb.

sections.title: A Noble Hypocrite
sections.body: Lord Baurles K. Wishock spends time in the Hall of Petitioners in Stormwind Keep, speaking of his own importance and the kingdom’s future. Patrons of the Slaughtered Lamb know another side of him. At night, he drinks in the tavern’s upper rooms and leaves large bills unpaid. By day, he petitions to have the tavern shut down.

sections.title: A Lethal Toast
sections.body: Zardeth of the Black Claw brews Black Claw Stout beneath the Slaughtered Lamb to settle Wishock’s debt for good. He says the drink carries quite a kick. In the Hall of Petitioners, Wishock mistakes the courier for a servant and tosses over a copper coin. He drinks the stout greedily, then collapses dead in the halls of the keep.

faq.q: Who is Zardeth of the Black Claw?
faq.answer: Zardeth of the Black Claw is a warlock with a hidden cabal in catacombs beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter. He carries out dangerous, secret operations beyond the city guard’s sight.

faq.q: Why does Zardeth target Lord Wishock?
faq.answer: Wishock drinks in the upper floors of the Slaughtered Lamb at night without paying his bills, then spends his days in the Hall of Petitioners asking the authorities to close the tavern.
Lord Baurles K. Wishock is found in the Hall of Petitioners, an antechamber in Stormwind Keep where nobles and citizens gather to lobby the realm’s regency.

faq.q: How does Lord Wishock receive the brew?
faq.answer: Wishock mistakes the courier for a servant, takes the stout as a refreshing drink, and dismisses them with a copper coin.

faq.q: Does delivering the stout attract the guards' attention?
faq.answer: The delivery appears to be an ordinary servant bringing a drink, and the courier can go on without a confrontation with the guards.
The delivery is followed by 'You Have Served Us Well,' which sends you back to Zardeth beneath the Slaughtered Lamb.
